First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 17–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @chicagounited.cc the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Chicago United Saturday BIPOC Ride group ride

Chicago United Saturday BIPOC Ride is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Comrade Cycles.

Chicago United is a nonprofit for the city’s BIPOC cycling community. The Saturday ride is no-drop and alternates between a north route to Highland Park and a south route to Wolf Lake. Details come from a community ride listing, so confirm on their Instagram. They also run a first-Wednesday Bite Ride to BIPOC-owned restaurants.
